name: Web Check
description: All-in-one OSINT tool for analysing any website
composeYaml:
services:
  web-check:
    image: lissy93/web-check:latest
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
